narrative.overview: Nutsty is a sheet of glass resting on the user's desktop. While nothing plays, the window is a dark acrylic pane at 58% and the wallpaper shows straight through. Once a song plays, a velvet backdrop fades in over 400ms, the album art blooms into a blurred aurora behind the content, and every interactive control takes on the song's colour. The interface never brings its own palette. It borrows one from the wallpaper and the cover art, through OKLAB chromatic salience extraction. The UI is dense and quiet, made of small type, hairline borders and concentric rounded corners; controls stay translucent and tinted and brighten on hover instead of rising off the surface.
keyCharacteristics: The accent is dynamic: the song's colour while playing, the wallpaper's colour while paused, and Honey Amber only as a fallback.
Layered translucency (wallpaper, then cover aurora, then content) instead of opaque panels.
Hairline 1px borders on every card, row, chip and cover.
Concentric radii: inner radius = outer radius minus padding.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: Interactive colour always comes from accentColor (or effectiveAccentColor). Never hardcode a brand hue on a control.

rules.name: The No Dead Grey Rule
rules.body: Buttons, pills, selectors and popovers never use flat greys such as white at 6 or 8%, #18181b or #27272a. Tint them with the accent instead.

rules.name: The Pause Shows the Wallpaper Rule
rules.body: Backdrop opacity is tied to win.currentTrack && win.isPlaying, never to currentTrack alone, otherwise pausing locks the window to opaque black.

rules.name: The Diacritic Fallback Rule
rules.body: Any serif display text must switch to Noto Serif when the string contains Vietnamese diacritics, as EnchantingSentence.qml does. Instrument Serif renders them wrong.

rules.name: The Never Fake Glass Rule
rules.body: Never replace Liquid Glass with a plain Rectangle of milky white at 10%. The glass backdrop source stays visible: true with opacity: 0.001. With visible: false the shader samples black.

rules.name: The Lite Mode Rule
rules.body: Every whole-window or per-frame effect must have a Lite mode path that keeps it static or switches it off.

rules.name: The Anti-Capsule Rule
rules.body: Never use radius = height / 2 on buttons, cards or badges. Mood chips are the explicit exception.

dos: Do read accentColor from win and derive every control state from it at 12, 22, 26 or 45% alpha.
Do put a 1px hairline on every card, row, chip and cover (white at 7% idle, 18% hover, accent at 45% active).
Do compute inner radii concentrically, and use RoundedImage.qml for every rounded image.
Do use SVG icons through AppIcon.qml, and pass all copy through I18n.tr().
Do provide a Lite mode path for any continuous or whole-window effect.
donts: Don't use emoji anywhere in the interface.
Don't use dead grey buttons or popovers (white at 6 or 8%, #18181b, #27272a).
Don't make capsules (radius = height / 2) except for mood chips.
Don't nest boxes inside boxes. Separate with space and hairlines.
Don't fake glass with a milky translucent rectangle, or hide the glass source with visible: false.
Don't give lyrics a white halo. Use cinematic shadows.
